title: Umuhamagara uturutse mu nyanja
intro: Tekereza umuntu wahawe ubutumwa bw'Imana, ariko mu kanya gato, agahita ava mu bantu be nta ruhushya rwemejwe. Uru rugendo rwabagejeje ku kigeragezo kidasanzwe, ikizamini gikomeye cyo kwihangana no kwishingikiriza ku Isumbabyose. Ni nde uyu muntu inkuru ye itwigisha ku kwihana no ku bwinshi bw'imbabazi za Allah?
clues: Noherejwe mu gihugu gikomeye, ariko kwangwa kwabo kwabanje kwanteye agahinda.
Navuye mu muryango wanjye, nizera ko ubutumwa bwanjye bwari burangiye, mbere yo guhabwa itegeko risobanutse ryo kugenda.
Nashatse inzira mu bwato, ariko inkubi y'umuyaga mwinshi n'ubufindo byatumye ngira ikibazo gikomeye.
Najugunywe mu nyanja, maze ikiremwa gikomeye cyo mu nyanja kiramira cyose.
Mu mwijima wo mu nda yayo, nahamagaye Allah, nemera ikosa ryanjye kandi nsaba imbabazi zayo.
Allah yategetse icyo kiremwa kunjugunya ku nkombe, maze nsubizwa ubuzima bwiza munsi y'igiti kidasanzwe.
verse: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy. (37:142)
